Bump LLVM to llvm/llvm-project@5ea5b9eb8eec (#24215)

Applied fixes for
https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/commit/86b9775612f8
- Drop `getSizeLevel()`, `isOptimizingForSize()`,
`OptimizationLevel::Os`, and `OptimizationLevel::Oz`, on the rationale
that size optimization should come from` O2 + optsize/minsize` function
attributes instead of pipeline-level `Os/Oz`.
